text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the appointed candidate are men, making sex discrimination between candidates virtually impossible. While an all-male panel may reflect poor institutional gender balance or diversity practices, citing it as bias against you will undermine your credibility. 

Your legitimate concern lies in qualifications: you hold a master's in educational leadership and five years of deputy principal experience, whereas the successful candidate has coursework and teaching experience. Rather than raising the panel's gender composition, follow up professionally on your request for written feedback. Frame your inquiry around the specific selection criteria, interview scoring, and how administrative leadership experience was weighted.
